description:
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Scion dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
The earthbent land will become a 0/0 creature and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. When the land dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Repeat.
